focus: deeper deltas across storage profile, dynamic Graph freshness, temporal causal provenance, dual execution recovery authority and stable terminal closure
hypothesis: Frank continuity improves if schema identity, semantic-head authority, pre-action causal provenance, current reconciliation authority and historical terminal validity are modeled as distinct typed receipts rather than inferred from mutually consistent current rows.
counterhypothesis: Additional receipts/order constraints may overconstrain recovery or increase persistence latency; A/B target measurements and explicit recovery-mode differentials must decide which constraints belong in the product path.
